thread:
sam: dropping a quick note from today's weekly check: cost-bot flagged Astra Labs (AST-02) for a spend surge vs their hosted commit. check please.
rita: saw the alert. delta +67% vs projection over trailing 7d.
cost-bot: ALERT: Astra Labs (AST-02) hosted spend anomaly. delta=+67% vs commit. top_routes=[/v1/generate,/v1/semantic_search], top_models=[rwdx-13b], spike_window=03:00-07:00 UTC.
ben (AE): their commit is 900k tokens/mo. current usage 620k projected 1.5M. pinging their eng lead @maya to confirm rollout.
telemetry-bot: brief metrics: p50 latency stable ~110ms, p95 increased 240ms->420ms. 5xx rose from 0.05% to 0.4% during spike. median input length up from 180 to 3,400 tokens.
sam: that median jump is concerning. any sign of retries or repeated identical requests?
telemetry-bot: yes - high duplicate fingerprints observed; several repeated payloads from the same API key between 03:10-03:40 UTC.
rita: likely a nightly backfill or a bug. options: 1) notify customer and offer guidance 2) temporary shaping window 3) top-up credits / commit amend. prefer to ask permission before shaping.
ben (AE): agree. i'll email Maya with the three options and include estimated overage cost.
sam: estimated overage if unchanged ~+600k tokens -> ~$2.4k. can we also surface top 5 offending request fingerprints in the ticket?
telemetry-bot: attached sanitized request fingerprints to CS-7619.
rita: policy we can apply if needed: policy_id=ast-night-shape, target=AST-02, window=02:00-08:00 UTC, action=shape_input_to_80rps, soft_threshold=810000.
ben (AE): Maya replied - they're rolling a new summarizer tonight and expects high load. asked for our help to avoid surprise billing. she prefers shaping + guidance over auto-top-up.
sam: ok proceed with soft shaping and a notification email at 80% commit. set internal alert to paging for >120% projection.
rita: creating CS ticket CS-7619 with action items: 1) apply soft-shape 02:00-08:00 UTC, 2) send customer playbook for prompt trimming and chunking, 3) add cost estimate to ticket.
ben (AE): i'll offer a one-time credit if they accept our recommended rate-limits and implement chunked requests.
sam: thanks team. marking this as amber -> mitigation in flight. will review at tomorrow's weekly.
